decision: Decision, 2026-10-28, scope set 2026-10-29: the one blind test of the final form (release 20261029, fitted to the training data of release 20261021) before any pending set is added to a fit. It holds every pending set of data/observations no earlier registry holds, and every pending set of data/hyperfine_parameters and data/x_hyperfine; the sets of the two earlier registries are forecast again in the partition read_before. Not scored: the pending atlas line lists (assigned to training) and the level, width, lifetime, intensity, other-state and theory tables (no forecast of the model, or one that needs a convention); they go to the split into train, calibrate and locked test
outcome_rule: values are read only by score_registry, after this registry exists; no refit, no model or setting selection, no exclusion of targets after scoring. A data correction found later is reported beside, not instead of, these scores
exclusion: 127I2 P(13) 43-0: diagnostic target only, never in a headline score

partitions.blind: nothing of this measurement is in any training set or an earlier registry
partitions.scored_before: an [overlaps] declaration ties it to a set of an earlier registry, whose values were read when that registry was scored
partitions.seen: an active set prints this measurement or a mean that contains it ([overlaps] same/mean)
partitions.superseded: an active set holds the same quantity re-measured or re-evaluated by the same authors ([overlaps] superseded)
partitions.read_before: a set of an earlier registry, whose values were read when that registry was scored; forecast again, never fitted, and never in a blind score

kinds.intraline: component minus component of the same line (hyperfine only)
kinds.interline: component (or center) of one line minus that of another
kinds.hf_constant: an effective hyperfine constant (eqQ, C, d or delta) of a line's B level, or of B minus X where the set's meta.toml kind says the source printed differences
kinds.x_constant: an effective hyperfine constant of an X level
kinds.x_interval: the energy of one hyperfine sublevel of an X level minus another's, E(I, F) - E(I', F'); sublevels are labeled (I, F) by a one-to-one assignment within each F (the largest total weight of each I on the level's own J); a set that prints magnitudes is scored on |forecast|

constants_scope: eqQ, C, d and delta of every row (a quantity a source did not print is not scored); summaries per kind and quantity
disclosure: While this registry was designed (2026-10-29), after release 20261029 was frozen and committed, values of some of its rows were displayed in a terminal, never compared with any model: yoshiki2023a (hyperfine_parameters, all 7 rows, and two values quoted in its meta.toml), borde2002 (x_hyperfine: 11 interval rows and 3 constants), wallerand1999 (one interval quoted in its meta.toml), koffend1978 (the v'' = 83 eqQ), robertsson2001b (eqQ', quoted in its meta.toml). The forecasts cannot depend on them; the quantity, sign and labeling rules were set from meta.toml text and identity columns

metrics.residual: observed - predicted (MHz), observed at zero pressure and power
metrics.scores: per model, partition, kind and set: n, rms, median |r|, mean, rms of r/sigma, fraction within each threshold; paired on targets every compared model predicts

uncertainty_note: sigma is the measurement uncertainty alone; |r|/sigma describes disagreement with the measurement, not model confidence. The primary forecasts also carry the model's frozen 1-sigma (sigma_model_MHz); coverage uses z = r / sqrt(sigma_model^2 + sigma^2)
